prompt.project_info: Create a high-energy studio portrait of an approved adult woman with controlled fisheye perspective and playful boxing props.

prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Strong frontal studio flash, crisp high-contrast shadows, vibrant saturated red, playful rebellious mood.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult platinum-blonde woman in a generic red corduroy cap, dark sunglasses, deep-red leather shirt-jacket, opaque black top, and cherry-red boxing gloves poses playfully under a controlled bird's-eye fisheye lens.
